lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho₂Mn₄Al₁₂ (reduced formula HoMn₂Al₆) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Ho and Mn each adopt 16-neighbor environments. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Al and Ho 12- and 16-vertex polyhedra, plus corner- and face-sharing between Al 12-vertex polyhedra.
